question: What benefits arise from ancestral rites under Maghā and Phālgunī constellations?
premises: Rites under Maghā yield offspring and prosperity
Rites under Phālgunī yield good fortune
inference: Worship under Maghā brings offspring and prosperity, and under Phālgunī brings good fortune.
uncertainties: exact distribution of results across the two timings is implied
plain_english: Under Maghā one obtains offspring and prosperity, and under Phālgunī good fortune.
